import pyBigWig, json, time
bw=pyBigWig.open('ENCFF822FDB.bigWig')
chroms={f'chr{i}':s for i in range(1,20) for s in [bw.chroms()[f'chr{i}']]}
rows=[]
t=time.time()
for chrom,size in chroms.items():
    n=size//1_000_000
    if n<=0: continue
    sums=bw.stats(chrom,0,n*1_000_000,type='sum',exact=True,nBins=n)
    # verify len
    for j,s in enumerate(sums):
        rows.append((chrom,j*1_000_000,(j+1)*1_000_000,s))
    print(chrom,n,time.time()-t)
print('total bins',len(rows),'time',time.time()-t)
rows_sorted=sorted(rows, key=lambda x:x[3], reverse=True)
for i,r in enumerate(rows_sorted[:20]):
    print(i+1, r[0], r[1], r[2], repr(r[3]))
# Save all rows
with open('bin_sums.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(rows, f)
PY"

import pyBigWig, time
bw=pyBigWig.open('ENCFF822FDB.bigWig')
chrom='chr8'; size=bw.chroms()[chrom]; n=size//1_000_000
# compute all nBins
arr=bw.stats(chrom,0,n*1_000_000,type='sum',exact=True,nBins=n)
# check first 5 and last 5 and top bin individual
for idx in list(range(5))+list(range(65,75))+[80]:
    one=bw.stats(chrom, idx*1_000_000, (idx+1)*1_000_000, type='sum', exact=True)[0]
    print(idx, one, arr[idx], one-arr[idx])
# also raw intervals sum for top bin 70M-71M
start=70000000; end=71000000
ints=bw.intervals(chrom,start,end)
manual=0.0
for s,e,v in ints:
    a=max(s,start); b=min(e,end)
    if b>a: manual += v*(b-a)
print('manual top',manual,arr[70])
print('n intervals',len(ints))
print('first last ints', ints[:5], ints[-5:])
PY"
